glyph_rationales.the migration of the sign: M13: zero converges distinct inventions — blank place, placeholder, numeral, origin — because the sign migrates between scripts and civilisations
glyph_rationales.the origin: M13: what the modern number line conceals — zero had to be earned as origin, not found already in place
glyph_rationales.the three operations: M14: Brahmagupta's payload — additive identity (a+0=a), multiplicative absorber (a·0=0), and the divisor a/0 as pressure-point
glyph_rationales.the containing algebra: M14: the box inside which the first two operations are stable — and against whose wall the third forces the system to state completion
glyph_rationales.the von Neumann chain: M15: 0=∅, 1={0}, n+1=n∪{n} — one generated from nothing, each finite ordinal gathering the prior as part of the next
glyph_rationales.the ordinals: M15: the growing finite ordinals — no second primitive numerical object beyond the empty set plus succession
glyph_rationales.the crossed zero: M16: the first occlusion of the recognition-matheme — the mediating stroke present but fused into the zero it crosses; the series inscribed as horizon, no further step performed
glyph_rationales.the mediating stroke: M16: the stroke legible as mediation — laid red over the identical geometry: uncrossing is not erasing, nothing is removed
glyph_rationales.the determinate mark: M16: the small square beyond the stroke's upper end — the mark the mediation makes available
glyph_rationales.the zero-space: M16: the circle's interior — the subject-pole not exhausted as object
glyph_rationales.division by zero: M17: the derivation 0·x=1 against 0·x=0 — the point at which the formal system must disclose its container
glyph_rationales.the sphere closes the plane: M17: the Riemann compactification — one completion among declared alternatives (projective point, wheels, meadows, transreal), each with purpose and cost
glyph_rationales.the earned pair: M18: 0/1 ↔ 1/0 — the indefinite condition becoming definite and the definite returning; the essay's own relational notation, now earned
glyph_rationales.the slash: M18: the act or means of differentiation — not a decorative separator; it carries provenance: what field, what exclusion, what mediation
glyph_rationales.the retained endpoints: M18: 0/1 and 1/0 as formal boundary fractions — between them the mediant field ramifies (Kaplan's pp. 204–207); the precise Stern–Brocot relation stays a specialist debt
